authority: PR #298 external outcome audit, comment 6119238901 (one read-only metadata-only cell-ID namespace diagnostic)

known_at_specification.exact_overlap: 0 within the G7 matrix->stem join, 0 per matrix against every shard, 0 globally
known_at_specification.syntax: Both sides use one three-field, '-'-delimited exp_component_name form: <16-nt barcode>-<chip/date/well token>-<numeric or UUID-like library id>. Shapes and length distributions match. Both are uppercase except the lowercase hex in UUID-like trailing fields. Neither side has a matrix/sample prefix or qualifier.

transforms.name: DROP_TRAILING_FIELD
transforms.role: descriptive; a match on barcode + chip/well blocks a disjointness conclusion

transforms.name: BARCODE_AND_TRAILING_FIELD
transforms.role: descriptive; a match on barcode + library id blocks a disjointness conclusion

transforms.name: BARCODE_ONLY
transforms.role: descriptive only; barcode reuse across libraries is expected by chance, so it never changes the classification

measurements_per_transform: per side: inputs, distinct outputs, global collisions (inputs - distinct outputs), collisions within any matrix/shard
overlap of distinct outputs: globally, per matrix vs its G7-joined stem, per matrix vs any shard
for overlapping outputs: whether each has exactly one preimage on each side (1:1)
decision_rule: 1. IDENTIFIER_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH if any 'can establish' transform (STRIP_WHITESPACE, UPPERCASE) is collision-free on both sides globally and yields global overlap >= 1 with every overlapping output 1:1.

2. Otherwise ID_NAMESPACE_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_ESTIMABLE if DROP_TRAILING_FIELD or BARCODE_AND_TRAILING_FIELD yields any global overlap. The same barcode within the same chip/well, or the same library, on both sides cannot be ruled in or out as one cell from metadata.

3. Otherwise GENUINELY_DISJOINT_NATURAL_CELL_SETS. Both namespaces share one documented format, no lossless transform yields overlap, and no barcode+chip/well or barcode+library match exists. BARCODE_ONLY results are reported but never change this.
Overlap is judged globally (any shard), the most conservative scope. Per-matrix and joined-stem scopes are reported.
forbidden: reading counts, H5AD values, G6 values or corrected-replay values
